look.direction: Ink and rust on white paper, made for a home printer. Pure white pages (a tint would print with a white frame where the printer cannot reach and wastes ink), deep blue-charcoal ink #1F2A33 at about 14.6:1 contrast, muted text #55606B at about 6.4:1 so small labels stay readable on paper and in dim light, and light gray-blue 1px writing lines that are clear but quiet under handwriting. One rust accent (#A8492B, 5.8:1) for date numbers and small markers; filled boxes such as This week's focus use a pale warm tint that costs little ink and still reads in grayscale. Two font families only (r016): Cormorant Garamond for headings and, in italic, for every label (theme labels: italic), and Jost for body text and numbers, with bold for links and weekday heads. No letter-spaced capitals, no motif, no florals, no script, no edge tabs. The result is editorial and calm, different from beige minimalism and from pastel rainbow bundles, and every page also prints well in black and white.

must_haves.what: A dated two-page spread for every week (Monday start, vertical day columns, a weekly focus list), the layout buyers came for.

A month page for every month with a full calendar grid, goals, important dates and bills, a month review page (wins, carry over, notes) facing the next month, plus a 2027 year at a glance and Dates to remember pages, so the weekly planner is complete without being a bundle.
True Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4 files that print cleanly on a home printer at Actual size, with white paper and nothing printed near the edge.
A printed Start here page with the four steps from download to binding.
A calm, well-made two-font design with consistent alignment on every page.
A small weekly habit strip on each week's right page (five habits by seven days), instead of separate tracker pages.

listing.description:
Open Week 2027 is a printable weekly planner for people who print and bind a paper planner and just want a good week: two pages for every week, from Monday, October 26, 2026 to Sunday, January 2, 2028. It comes in true Letter and A4 files that print cleanly on a home printer.

What's inside: 164 pages in each file, Monday start
- Cover and a Start here page: four steps from download to binding
- Print check: one sheet to print first, with true-size inch and centimetre rulers, four corner marks, binding-edge hole guides, a line and tone sample, a pen test and, on the back, a fix list and the settings that work
- Print map: the page range and number of sheets for every month, with a box to tick when it is printed
- 2027 at a glance
- Dates to remember: 2 pages, 26 lines each, with a Done box
- Head start for November and December 2026: a month page and a month review page for each month, with 10 week spreads from Monday, October 26 to Sunday, January 3
- 12 month pages for 2027, each with a calendar grid and week numbers, Goals this month, Important dates and Bills and payments, plus a month review page (Wins this month, Carry over to next month, Notes)
- 52 dated week spreads for 2027, Week 1 (Jan 4 to Jan 10) to Week 52 (Dec 27 to Jan 2, 2028). Week numbers follow the ISO standard used for work and school weeks
- 1 undated spare week spread with a notes page on each side, to reprint as often as you like

Every week spread
- Left page: This week's focus, then Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday in tall columns with 3 tick boxes and writing lines each
- Right page: Thursday, Friday, and Saturday over Sunday, then Habits this week (5 habits by 7 days) and a To do list

Good to know: dated weeks only, no daily pages. Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4 only, no A5 or Classic Happy Planner size. The Letter file fits standard 3-ring binders and Big Happy Planner discs. Plain white pages that also print well in black and white.

What makes it different
- Prints right the first time. Every page keeps half an inch clear on all sides, so a home printer cuts nothing off, and the wider binding margin swaps sides on the front and back so nothing gets punched through.
- A print check before you print the whole planner. Print one sheet, hold a real ruler to it and look at the corner marks. If something is off, the fix is printed on the back of the same sheet.
- Print one month at a time. Each Print map row is whole sheets and lists the dates of the weeks it holds: print it double-sided and it drops into your binder in order, with every week open as a two-page spread. Page numbers are printed on every page after the cover and match in both files.
- Start the day you buy it. Find today's date in the Weeks column of the Print map, print that row and start with this week. The first week begins Monday, October 26, 2026.
- Exactly the weekly layout, nothing to dig through. No 600 page bundle: just the week, the month and a few front pages you will use.
- A calm editorial look in ink blue with one rust accent, set in two typefaces: Cormorant Garamond for headings and Jost for everything else.
- On screen, the PDF links too: dates open their week and the arrows move between weeks.

Works with
- Any home printer that prints Letter or A4, double-sided or one side at a time
- Any PDF reader, such as Adobe Acrobat Reader, Preview or Chrome
- No app, account or subscription needed

How to start
1. Download on a computer: on Etsy, open You, then Purchases, then Download files, in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download files.
2. Print the check sheet (pages 3 to 4) double-sided at Actual size and check the ruler and corners.
3. Print pages 1 to 2 and 5 to 8, then the Print map row whose weeks hold today's date, and punch or bind.

What you get
- Open-Week-2027-Letter.pdf (1.46 MB, 164 pages) for US Letter paper
- Open-Week-2027-A4.pdf (1.46 MB, 164 pages) for A4 paper
Digital download. Nothing is shipped. Print as many copies for your own use as you like.

Help: fixes for the usual print problems (also printed on the back of the Print check sheet)
- Ruler too short or pages shrunk: set Scale to Actual size or 100% and turn off Fit to page.
- A corner mark is missing: set the paper size to match the file, Letter or A4.
- Back side upside down: choose Flip on long edge.
- No double-sided printer: print the odd pages, put the stack back in the tray blank side to print with the top edge going in first, then print the even pages. Try it on the check sheet first.
- Too much ink: print in grayscale or draft; every page works in black and white.
- The file will not download: use a web browser, not the Etsy app (You, Purchases, Download files).
Still stuck? Send the shop an Etsy message.
